Hi all — thanks for the docs, Elena. I pulled this through with our tax counsel. Summary:

- For US 1099 reporting, payments to foreign entities that are corporations are generally not subject to 1099-MISC/NEC. A properly completed W-8BEN-E is typically the correct form for a non-US corporate payee and will support exemption from 1099 reporting (assuming the entity is not a US person).
- Withholding: standard vendor payments to a foreign corporation for services performed entirely outside the US are usually exempt from US backup withholding, but withholding outcomes can depend on chapter 3 chapter 61 status and whether there's any US source income.

What we need to complete our AP checklist and release payment:
1) Completed W-8BEN-E (we need Part I and the chapter 3 status filled; it looks signed but please confirm all relevant parts are populated).
2) Beneficial owner attestation (short form) — confirms there are no US owners requiring 1099 reporting.
3) Proof of bank details (bank statement or voided bank letter) matching the payee name.
4) Company registration extract (you sent — thanks).

I've uploaded a short invoice-release checklist (finance_invoice_release_checklist.pdf) and created a DocuSign for the ACH/wire remittance authorization: https://docusign.example.com/NDX-998273-release-form (expires in 7 days).

If Elena can return the attestation + confirm the W-8 sections, we can schedule the EUR wire for release the next AP run (target date: Thu 2026-09-02).
